_doc: Wave-5 Specialization trees (Fable, 2026-11-11; design in docs/SPECS.md "Wave 5"; the roster in data/specs.json). The last wave: Runesmith (Fighter), Scavenger and Shade Dancer (Rogue), Starcaller, Sorcerer and Enchanter (Mage) - three trees each, 10 nodes a tree, levels 10/11/12/14/16/18/20, ranks to 10 (short utilities 3-5). SAME SCHEMA as skills-specs-1..4.json. No hybrids, so no altCost; no stance in this wave. HOW THE COUNTERS ARE WRITTEN WITHOUT A COUNTER: a Runesmith's rune is a dot (Rune Hammer's bleed, Searing Rune's burn, Forge Flame's coat), so Runebreaker and The Great Anvil count them with `perDot`; a Starcaller's star is a 6 s storm dot lodged in the target (Star Dart, Scattered Stars, Wheeling Stars) and the big casts (Star Shard, Greater Star, Constellation, Heavens' Barrage, Skyfall) spend them with `perDot` - the constellation is on the TARGET, not the caster, which is the one difference from the design; the Sorcerer's Arcane Burst counts kinds of harm with `perDot` too (every kind here is a dot), and Sixfold Ruin is six typed damage effects in one skill, each resolved against its own resistance. The Enchanter's sleep is a stun and Arcane Jolt pays x2 on it through `cond: { slowed }` (stun, root and slow all count). The Shade Dancer's afterimage is a second, lighter `weapon` hit in the same skill; its behind-the-target cuts use the row-level `cond: 'behindBonus'` + `frontMult`. The Scavenger's gambles are crit bursts, an under-half execute and the spendAll Big Score (doubled under 35%) until the dice exist. Phantasms and the Tin Can Trap are `stay` minions at the pointer with a taunt. NUMBERS as waves 1-4. Everything here runs on the engine today except the ideas in `wishlist`, each written as its fallback.

rns_rune_hammer.name: Rune Hammer
rns_rune_hammer.desc: Strike a rune into the target: {mult} weapon damage and the rune bleeds {dmg} a second for 8 seconds. Every rune on a target counts when the anvil falls. Your filler.

rns_rend_plate.name: Rend Plate
rns_rend_plate.desc: Peel the plate back: {mult} weapon damage and the target's armour down 20% for 8 seconds.

rns_deeper_rune.name: Deeper Rune
rns_deeper_rune.desc: Rune Hammer strikes deeper per rank.

rns_searing_rune.name: Searing Rune
rns_searing_rune.desc: A rune of fire: {dmg} fire damage and it burns for 8 seconds. A second rune on the target. Instant.

rns_hammerfall.name: Hammerfall
rns_hammerfall.desc: The hammer down on the ground: {mult} weapon damage to everything within 4 m of the target and a short stun.

rns_lasting_rune.name: Lasting Rune
rns_lasting_rune.desc: Rune Hammer's rune bleeds longer per rank.

rns_runebreaker.name: Runebreaker
rns_runebreaker.desc: Break every rune on the target at once: {mult} weapon damage, then {dmg} more, +30% for every rune, poison or curse on it (up to +120%), and a 1.5 second stun. The Hammer capstone.

rns_runeskin.name: Runeskin
rns_runeskin.desc: Runes on your own skin: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds that strikes back at whatever hits you, and +15% armour while it holds.

rns_warding_glyph.name: Warding Glyph
rns_warding_glyph.desc: A glyph on a friend within 20 m: a {dmg} ward and +15% armour for 8 seconds.

rns_harder_skin.name: Harder Skin
rns_harder_skin.desc: Runeskin wards for more per rank.

rns_rune_of_holding.name: Rune of Holding
rns_rune_of_holding.desc: A rune that pulls: everything within 8 m turns on you and is slowed 20% for 3 seconds, and 10 temper. Does not use the global cooldown.

rns_glyph_wall.name: Glyph Wall
rns_glyph_wall.desc: Glyphs on everyone: a {dmg} ward on every friend within 10 m for 8 seconds.

rns_brighter_glyph.name: Brighter Glyph
rns_brighter_glyph.desc: Warding Glyph wards for more per rank.

rns_runeward.name: Runeward
rns_runeward.desc: Every rune you know, lit at once: a {dmg} ward that strikes back hard, +40% armour for 10 seconds, everything within 8 m turns on you and hits 15% softer, and 30 temper. The Runeskin capstone.

rns_forge_flame.name: Forge Flame
rns_forge_flame.desc: Light the weapon at the forge: for 20 seconds every hit you land leaves fire burning for 6. The burn counts as a rune.

rns_hammer_shout.name: Hammer Shout
rns_hammer_shout.desc: A shout off the anvil: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {mult} weapon damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

rns_molten_strike.name: Molten Strike
rns_molten_strike.desc: The hammer straight from the fire: {mult} weapon damage and {dmg} fire damage on top.

rns_hotter_forge.name: Hotter Forge
rns_hotter_forge.desc: Forge Flame burns harder per rank.

rns_forge_blast.name: Forge Blast
rns_forge_blast.desc: Open the furnace door: {dmg} fire damage to everything in a 90 degree cone, and all of it burns for 6 seconds.

rns_molten_core.name: Molten Core
rns_molten_core.desc: Molten Strike hits harder per rank.

rns_great_anvil.name: The Great Anvil
rns_great_anvil.desc: The anvil falls: {mult} weapon damage to the target, then {dmg} to everything within 6 m of it, +30% for every rune, poison or curse each one carries (up to +120%) and more the more it hits, and a 1.5 second stun on all of it. The Forge capstone.

scv_lucky_strike.name: Lucky Strike
scv_lucky_strike.desc: A swing with your eyes shut: {mult} weapon damage and +12% critical chance for 5 seconds. Your filler.

scv_loaded_dice.name: Loaded Dice
scv_loaded_dice.desc: Whatever the dice say: {mult} weapon damage and a crackle of {dmg} storm damage that slows for 2 seconds.

scv_luckier.name: Luckier
scv_luckier.desc: Lucky Strike hits harder per rank.

scv_double_or_nothing.name: Double or Nothing
scv_double_or_nothing.desc: Bet the hand: {mult} weapon damage, half again on anything under half health.

scv_hot_streak.name: Hot Streak
scv_hot_streak.desc: The streak: +15% damage and +15% critical chance for 8 seconds, and 20 energy. Does not use the global cooldown.

scv_bigger_bet.name: Bigger Bet
scv_bigger_bet.desc: Double or Nothing hits harder per rank.

scv_jackpot.name: Jackpot
scv_jackpot.desc: All the bells at once: {mult} weapon damage, a burst of {dmg} fire over 4 m round the target, and 30 energy back. The Lucky capstone.

scv_junk_toss.name: Junk Toss
scv_junk_toss.desc: Throw whatever is in your hand from 15 m: {mult} weapon damage and a 30% slow for 2 seconds. The filler at range.

scv_caltrops.name: Caltrop Scatter
scv_caltrops.desc: Caltrops over 4 m where you point: everything in them is held for 1.5 seconds and bleeds for 4. Lands at the pointer.

scv_pitch_bomb.name: Rag-and-Pitch Bomb
scv_pitch_bomb.desc: A bottle of pitch with a burning rag in it: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 4 m of where it lands, burning for 5 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

scv_more_pitch.name: More Pitch
scv_more_pitch.desc: The pitch bomb covers more ground per rank.

scv_tin_can_trap.name: Tin Can Trap
scv_tin_can_trap.desc: A rattling can on a string where you point: everything within 6 m of it goes for the noise for {secs} seconds or until it is stamped flat. Counts as a minion.

scv_bottle_rocket.name: Bottle Rocket
scv_bottle_rocket.desc: A firework in the face: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} fire damage. From 15 m; does not use the global cooldown.

scv_junk_avalanche.name: Junk Avalanche
scv_junk_avalanche.desc: The whole cart, tipped: {dmg} damage to everything within 6 m of where you point, more the more it hits (up to +40%), a 1 second stun and a 40% slow for 3. Lands at the pointer. The Junk capstone.

scv_scrounge.name: Scrounge
scv_scrounge.desc: Pick through the pockets: {dmg} health back and 15 energy. Instant.

scv_pocket_sand.name: Pocket Sand
scv_pocket_sand.desc: Sand in the eyes: {mult} weapon damage, the target hits 20% softer for 5 seconds, and you hop 4 m back.

scv_sucker_punch.name: Sucker Punch
scv_sucker_punch.desc: The one they were not watching for: {mult} weapon damage and a 1 second stun.

scv_shiny_things.name: Shiny Things
scv_shiny_things.desc: Hang something shiny on the target: {dmg} damage, and it takes 15% more from everyone for 8 seconds. From 15 m.

scv_harder_punch.name: Harder Punch
scv_harder_punch.desc: Sucker Punch hits harder per rank.

scv_big_score.name: Big Score
scv_big_score.desc: Everything on one roll: spends every point of energy for {mult} weapon damage, +1.5% a point past the cost, DOUBLED on anything under 35% health. The Big Score capstone.

str_star_dart.name: Star Dart
str_star_dart.desc: A thrown star for {dmg} storm damage that lodges in the target and glows for 6 seconds. Every star glowing on a target is one more for the big ones to spend. A one second cast; your filler.

str_scattered_stars.name: Scattered Stars
str_scattered_stars.desc: A handful at once: {dmg} storm damage to everything within 5 m of the target and a star lodged in each.

str_sharper_dart.name: Sharper Dart
str_sharper_dart.desc: Star Dart hits harder per rank.

str_twin_stars.name: Twin Stars
str_twin_stars.desc: Two stars off the fingers for {dmg} storm damage each. Instant.

str_star_shard.name: Star Shard
str_star_shard.desc: A shard of a bigger star: {dmg} fire damage, +25% for every star, poison or curse glowing on the target (up to +100%).

str_longer_glow.name: Longer Glow
str_longer_glow.desc: Star Dart's star glows longer per rank.

str_constellation.name: Constellation
str_constellation.desc: Join the stars on the target: {dmg} storm damage, +30% for every star, poison or curse on it (up to +150%), and a burst over 5 m round it. The Darts capstone.

str_called_star.name: Called Star
str_called_star.desc: Call one down where you point: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 4 m and a short stun. Lands at the pointer; the other filler.

str_falling_star.name: Falling Star
str_falling_star.desc: Ride a star 8 m forward and land burning: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 4 m of where you come down.

str_bigger_star.name: Bigger Star
str_bigger_star.desc: Called Star hits harder per rank.

str_hush_of_stars.name: Hush of Stars
str_hush_of_stars.desc: A star in the mouth: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} storm damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

str_greater_star.name: Greater Star
str_greater_star.desc: A bigger one, slower to come: {dmg} fire damage to everything within 5 m of where you point, +25% for every star on each (up to +100%), and a 30% slow for 3 seconds.

str_wider_star.name: Wider Star
str_wider_star.desc: Greater Star covers more ground per rank.

str_heavens_barrage.name: Heavens' Barrage
str_heavens_barrage.desc: Four seconds of stars where you point: each second {dmg} fire damage to everything within 6 m, +20% for every star on each (up to +80%), and a slow. The Called capstone.

str_star_field.name: Star Field
str_star_field.desc: Lay a field of stars 5 m across where you point: for 8 seconds everything in it is stung for {dmg} storm damage a second and slowed 20%. Lands at the pointer.

str_star_ward.name: Star Ward
str_star_ward.desc: Stars round you: a {dmg} ward for 8 seconds that throws storm back at whatever hits you.

str_lasting_field.name: Lasting Field
str_lasting_field.desc: Star Field lasts longer per rank.

str_wheeling_stars.name: Wheeling Stars
str_wheeling_stars.desc: Stars wheel round you: {dmg} storm damage to everything within 6 m and a star lodged in each.

str_bright_field.name: Bright Field
str_bright_field.desc: A field of kind stars 6 m across where you point: everyone standing in it, companions too, is healed for {dmg} a second for 8 seconds.

str_wider_wheel.name: Wider Wheel
str_wider_wheel.desc: Wheeling Stars hits harder per rank.

str_skyfall.name: Skyfall
str_skyfall.desc: The sky comes down 8 m across where you point: {dmg} fire damage to everything there, +30% for every star on each (up to +150%), more the more it hits, a 1 second stun, and a field that keeps stinging for 6 seconds. The Fields capstone.

sor_wild_bolt.name: Wild Bolt
sor_wild_bolt.desc: A bolt of whatever came to hand, storm this time: {dmg} damage. A short cast; your filler.

sor_flux.name: Flux
sor_flux.desc: The fire kind: {dmg} fire damage and it burns for 5 seconds. Instant.

sor_wilder_bolt.name: Wilder Bolt
sor_wilder_bolt.desc: Wild Bolt hits harder per rank.

sor_chaos_shard.name: Chaos Shard
sor_chaos_shard.desc: The cold kind: {dmg} frost damage and a 30% slow for 3 seconds. Instant.

sor_wild_surge.name: Wild Surge
sor_wild_surge.desc: All of it at once over 5 m round the target: {dmg} storm damage to everything there, more the more it hits (up to +40%), and poison seeping into each for 6 seconds.

sor_bigger_surge.name: Bigger Surge
sor_bigger_surge.desc: Wild Surge hits harder per rank.

sor_arcane_burst.name: Arcane Burst
sor_arcane_burst.desc: Everything on the target goes off: {dmg} storm damage, +35% for every burn, poison or curse it carries (up to +140%), and a 1 second stun. The Wild capstone.

sor_mana_rend.name: Mana Rend
sor_mana_rend.desc: Tear the magic out of the target: {dmg} shadow damage and 10 mana into you. Instant; it pays for itself.

sor_overchannel.name: Overchannel
sor_overchannel.desc: Pull more through than is safe: +25% damage and +20% cast speed for 10 seconds. Free; the price is on the wishlist.

sor_deeper_rend.name: Deeper Rend
sor_deeper_rend.desc: Mana Rend tears more per rank.

sor_blood_ward.name: Blood Ward
sor_blood_ward.desc: A ward written in your own blood: {dmg} absorbed for 8 seconds and 20 mana back.

sor_rend_asunder.name: Rend Asunder
sor_rend_asunder.desc: Tear it out of all of them: {dmg} shadow damage to everything within 5 m of the target, they hit 10% softer for 5 seconds, and 20 mana into you.

sor_burning_veins.name: Burning Veins
sor_burning_veins.desc: Open the veins: +40% damage and +40% cast speed for 8 seconds, 60 mana, and {dmg} fire damage to everything within 6 m as the magic comes out of you. The Overchannel capstone.

sor_ruin_bolt.name: Ruin Bolt
sor_ruin_bolt.desc: A bolt that unmakes: {dmg} shadow damage, and the target hits 10% softer for 5 seconds. A short cast.

sor_transmute.name: Transmute
sor_transmute.desc: Turn the target into something harmless for 3 seconds; when it comes back it is shaken, hitting 30% softer for 6.

sor_unmaking.name: Unmaking
sor_unmaking.desc: Unmake the words: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {dmg} shadow damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

sor_entropic_lash.name: Entropic Lash
sor_entropic_lash.desc: A lash of ruin: {dmg} shadow damage now and a curse eating at the target for 6 seconds. Instant.

sor_heavier_ruin.name: Heavier Ruin
sor_heavier_ruin.desc: Ruin Bolt hits harder per rank.

sor_sixfold_ruin.name: Sixfold Ruin
sor_sixfold_ruin.desc: Every kind of harm at once: {dmg} each of fire, frost, storm, poison, shadow and plain force, each against its own resistance, and a burst of storm over 4 m round the target. The Ruin capstone.

enc_drowse.name: Drowse
enc_drowse.desc: Send the target to sleep for 3 seconds. Pick the fight: put one down, deal with the rest. Instant, from 25 m.

enc_arcane_jolt.name: Arcane Jolt
enc_arcane_jolt.desc: A jolt for {dmg} storm damage, DOUBLED on anything asleep, held or slowed. Your filler.

enc_mass_drowse.name: Mass Drowse
enc_mass_drowse.desc: Everything within 5 m of where you point falls asleep for 2 seconds. Lands at the pointer.

enc_rude_awakening.name: Rude Awakening
enc_rude_awakening.desc: A jolt through everything within 5 m of the target: {dmg} storm damage, half again on anything asleep, held or slowed, and a half-second daze.

enc_sharper_jolt.name: Sharper Jolt
enc_sharper_jolt.desc: Arcane Jolt hits harder per rank.

enc_deep_sleep.name: Deep Sleep
enc_deep_sleep.desc: Everything within 8 m of where you point sleeps for 4 seconds and dreams badly: {dmg} shadow damage. The Drowse capstone.

enc_beguile.name: Beguile
enc_beguile.desc: Turn the target's head: it stands dazed for 2 seconds and takes 20% more from everyone for 6. From 25 m.

enc_lethargy.name: Lethargy
enc_lethargy.desc: Everything within 6 m of the target cannot be bothered: slowed 40% and hitting 15% softer for 5 seconds.

enc_hush.name: Hush
enc_hush.desc: A finger to the lips: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for 1.5, with {dmg} shadow damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

enc_befuddle.name: Befuddle
enc_befuddle.desc: Muddle the target: {dmg} shadow damage, it hits 20% softer for 8 seconds and is slowed 30% for 4. Instant.

enc_wider_lethargy.name: Wider Lethargy
enc_wider_lethargy.desc: Lethargy covers more ground per rank.

enc_puppet.name: Puppet
enc_puppet.desc: Take the target's strings: it stands still for 4 seconds, takes 30% more from everyone for 8, and {dmg} shadow damage as you pull. The Beguile capstone; the charm proper is on the wishlist.

enc_phantasm.name: Phantasm
enc_phantasm.desc: A shape of you where you point that lulls whatever comes near: everything within 6 m of it goes for it for {secs} seconds or until it fades. Stands where it is put; counts as a minion.

enc_mirror_ward.name: Mirror Ward
enc_mirror_ward.desc: Hard to be sure which one is you: a {dmg} ward and +15 dodge for 8 seconds.

enc_truer_mirror.name: Truer Mirror
enc_truer_mirror.desc: Mirror Ward wards for more per rank.

enc_slip_away.name: Slip Away
enc_slip_away.desc: Be 10 m further on with a {dmg} ward for 4 seconds. Does not use the global cooldown.

enc_twin_phantasms.name: Twin Phantasms
enc_twin_phantasms.desc: Two shapes where you point, each lulling what comes within 5 m, for {secs} seconds. They count as minions.

enc_grand_enthrallment.name: Grand Enthrallment
enc_grand_enthrallment.desc: The whole room, taken: everything within 10 m of you sleeps for 3 seconds and takes {dmg} shadow damage, and three phantasms rise round you to hold whatever wakes. The Phantasm capstone.

shd_shade_cut.name: Shade Cut
shd_shade_cut.desc: A cut for {mult} weapon damage, and your afterimage cuts again a moment later for 40% of it. Your filler.

shd_twin_shade.name: Twin Shade
shd_twin_shade.desc: Two cuts, two shades: {mult} weapon damage twice.

shd_darker_cut.name: Darker Cut
shd_darker_cut.desc: Shade Cut cuts deeper per rank.

shd_shade_lash.name: Shade Lash
shd_shade_lash.desc: A lash through a 90 degree arc: {mult} weapon damage to everything in it, and the afterimage lashes again for 40%.

shd_lingering_shade.name: Lingering Shade
shd_lingering_shade.desc: A cut for {mult} weapon damage whose afterimage keeps cutting: {dmg} shadow damage a second for 6 seconds.

shd_second_shade.name: Second Shade
shd_second_shade.desc: Twin Shade cuts deeper per rank.

shd_cutting_waltz.name: Cutting Waltz
shd_cutting_waltz.desc: Dance through everything within 6 m: {mult} weapon damage to each, more the more you hit (up to +40%), and the afterimage dances it again for half. The Afterimage capstone.

shd_umbral_step.name: Umbral Step
shd_umbral_step.desc: Step 10 m through the dark to the target and cut for {mult} weapon damage: full from behind, 70% from the front.

shd_shroud.name: Shroud
shd_shroud.desc: Wrap a friend within 20 m in shadow: a {dmg} ward and +15 dodge for 8 seconds.

shd_thicker_shroud.name: Thicker Shroud
shd_thicker_shroud.desc: Shroud wards for more per rank.

shd_smother.name: Smother
shd_smother.desc: A hand of shadow over the mouth: stops what the target is casting, locks it for 3 seconds and silences it for one, with {mult} weapon damage. Does not use the global cooldown.

shd_dark_cut.name: Dark Cut
shd_dark_cut.desc: The cut from the dark: {mult} weapon damage from behind, 60% of it from the front.

shd_deeper_dark.name: Deeper Dark
shd_deeper_dark.desc: Dark Cut cuts deeper per rank.

shd_assassinate.name: Assassinate
shd_assassinate.desc: Finish it: {mult} weapon damage, DOUBLED on anything under 35% health, full from behind and 70% from the front. The Umbral Step capstone.

shd_shade.name: Shade
shd_shade.desc: Leave a shade of yourself that fights beside you for {secs} seconds, striking what you strike. Counts as a minion (up to eight).

shd_veil.name: Veil
shd_veil.desc: Drop 6 m back behind a {dmg} ward, and the next 5 seconds crit 15% more.

shd_shade_dance.name: Shade Dance
shd_shade_dance.desc: Dance with the shades: +15% damage for 8 seconds and 15 energy. Does not use the global cooldown.

shd_shade_pair.name: Shade Pair
shd_shade_pair.desc: Two shades at once for {secs} seconds. They count as minions.

shd_longer_pair.name: Longer Pair
shd_longer_pair.desc: Shade Pair lasts longer per rank.

shd_host_of_shades.name: Host of Shades
shd_host_of_shades.desc: A host of four shades for {secs} seconds, each striking what you strike, and you hit 20% harder for 15 while they dance. They count as minions. The Host capstone.

wishlist.field: counter: runes / starlight (a real stack on the target or caster)
wishlist.on: rns_runebreaker, rns_great_anvil, str_star_shard, str_constellation, str_skyfall, str_heavens_barrage
wishlist.rule: `stack: { id: 'rune', max: 5, secs: 8 }` on an effect adds one; `perStack: { id, mult, consume: true }` on another reads and spends them. Written today as dots counted by `perDot`, which already means "one more thing on the target pays off the big hit"; the difference is that a Starcaller's starlight was meant to be on the CASTER (any target's stars count) and that other dots (a Rogue's poison) count too.
`perDebuffKind: { mult: 0.35, max: 1.4 }`: +mult per DISTINCT fx kind on the target (dot, slow, root, stun, silence, armourDown, mark...). perDot today counts dots only.
`polymorph: { secs: 4 }`: the target walks slowly, casts nothing, hits for nothing and breaks on damage; the browser swaps its look. Written today as a 3 s stun + 30% weaken.

wishlist.field: afterimage (a delayed repeat of the hit)
wishlist.rule: `afterimage: { delay: 0.6, mult: 0.4 }` on a weapon effect: the same blow lands again after delay at mult (a queued event in w, with its own `k: 'shade'` event for the picture). Written today as a second weapon effect in the same skill, which lands at once.
`copy: true` on a summon: the minion repeats the caster's last weapon skill at its own dmgMult instead of its own strike list. Today a shade is a melee minion with a 1.3x strike every 5 s.
